smol-01-c2.text: H. Peter Lu, Luying Xun, X. Sunney Xie (1998). Single-Molecule Enzymatic Dynamics. Science 282(5395), 1877-1882.
smol-01-c2.quote: There exists a memory effect: an enzymatic turnover is not independent of its previous turnovers.
smol-01-c2.claim: Catalytic turnover times within one molecule's trajectory are correlated: a slow turnover is followed by another slow turnover, which suggests the conformation persists.
